# 08 · The Tall Hearth
Population as the multiplier; the guilds are the passive late act, spending citizens the
active one. Wins by: The Metropolis · The Greatest City · The Census of the World.

- Orders: Granary Levies (the growth trigger — multiply this shape) · Public Granaries · Hearth Songs · Festival Days
- Religion: Goddess of the Harvest · Keeper of the Hearth · River Mother
- Wonders: The Hanging Gardens
- Deeds: The Breadbasket
